scripts.deploy:demo: bun run build:demo && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.demo.jsonc
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '*' typecheck && bun run typecheck:tooling

DATABASE_URL.description: Connection string of an empty PostgreSQL 16+ database for **fictional data only**, e.g. a free [Neon](https://neon.tech) project: Dashboard → Connect → turn *Connection pooling* **off** → copy the `postgresql://…?sslmode=require` string. The first start migrates it and seeds fictional workers.

APP_SECRET.description: Any random string of **at least 32 characters** (e.g. `openssl rand -base64 33`). Signs sign-in tokens and seals authenticator secrets; changing it later signs everyone out and voids their two-factor set-up.

DEMO_PASSWORD.description: Password for the six demo accounts (`owner`, `ops.manager`, `hr.officer`, `payroll.officer`, `finance.officer`, `admin`). **At least 12 characters**, not containing any of those usernames. Give it only to the people you show the demo to.

R2_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your Cloudflare **account ID** (32 characters): R2 Object Storage → Overview, right-hand side.

R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: From R2 Object Storage → **Manage API tokens** → Create token with *Object Read & Write* on the `mms-demo-scans` bucket: the **Access Key ID**.

R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: The **Secret Access Key** shown once with the token above.

SCANS_BUCKET_NAME.description: Name of the R2 bucket for document scans. Leave `mms-demo-scans`; if you rename the bucket above, use the same name here.
